bio: This trendy and lively spot is in the heart of Schwerin – the cathedral is very close by and the castle is also within easy walking distance. The atmosphere is laid-back and casual in this maisonette-style restaurant occupying two levels, and on the lower floor, diners can choose between high tables or counter seats with views of action in the kitchen. This place specialises in delicious izakaya cuisine – predominantly Asian dishes and finger food for sharing. On certain days, they also propose an ambitious tasting menu. Don't forget to book!...
